item.title: South Dakota Vetoes Lab-Grown Meat Ban
item.description: On Monday, February 9, South Dakota Governor, Larry Rhoden vetoed a bill (H.B. 1077) that would have banned cell-cultured meat, also referred to as lab-grown or cultivated meat. If signed into law, cell-cultured meat would have been added to the state’s “adulterated” foods list.
